contradictions.title: Workspace Concept vs Platform-First
contradictions.new_fundamental_truths_says: Thread Management: 'Chat cascade threads tied to Project ID and Workspace for RAG context'
contradictions.adr_034_says: AMENDMENT-001 eliminates workspace concept entirely: 'The concept of "workspaces" (IDE, Notes, etc.) is ELIMINATED'
contradictions.resolution_detail: Remove 'Workspace' from thread management description. Threads should be tied to Project ID only, not Workspace.

contradictions.title: Route Structure References
contradictions.adr_034_says: AMENDMENT-001 eliminates these routes: 'Replace 9 routes with 2: /hub and /$projectId' and 'Old routes are deprecated and redirect to /$projectId'
contradictions.resolution_detail: Replace all references to /ide/$projectId and /notes/$projectId with /$projectId. Document should reference platform-filtered plugins, not workspace-based routes.
